shared_elements: incised/carved border band framing the decorated field
rounded/arched top slab field filled with design
justification: Both surfaces are arched-topped panels whose decoration is contained by a marginal framing band, and both use rounded, spiral/scroll-like curvilinear forms, but this is a generic correspondence. A is a dense, strictly ordered grid of deeply carved rectangular cartouches (each an enclosed sign, some containing face-like heads), while B is a sparse, freely composed field of shallow incised spirals with an elongated animal in profile along the top edge; neither the elements nor their relationships correspond specifically.
